description: Create a TLS secret in Code Engine by reading certificate and key PEM files from disk. Use this after obtaining a cert with certbot. The cert and key are read from the given file paths and stored as a Code Engine secret of format "tls".

cert_pem_path.description: Absolute path to the certificate PEM file (e.g. ~/certbot/config/live/<domain>/fullchain.pem)

key_pem_path.description: Absolute path to the private key PEM file (e.g. ~/certbot/config/live/<domain>/privkey.pem)

secret_name.description: Name for the TLS secret (e.g. my-domain-tls)

name: ce_create_tls_secret_from_pem
